title: Netherlands Provinces
description: The 12 provinces of the Netherlands, administrative boundaries from the Dutch national spatial data infrastructure PDOK, derived from the Kadaster BRK Bestuurlijke Gebieden. Republished as cloud-native GeoParquet with a PMTiles visualization and categorical, labeled MapLibre styles.

table:columns.name: fid
table:columns.description: Feature id from the source GeoPackage layer, 1 to 12. Unique in this file.

table:columns.name: identificatie
table:columns.description: Province identifier PV20 through PV31, PV plus the CBS province code. The join key to CBS StatLine regional tables.

table:columns.name: naam
table:columns.description: Official province name. Fryslân carries its official Frisian spelling, a filter on Friesland returns nothing.

table:columns.name: code
table:columns.description: Two-digit CBS province code as a string, 20 through 31. Joins to ligt_in_provincie_code in the source's municipality layer.

table:columns.name: ligt_in_land_code
table:columns.description: Country code, the constant 6030 for Nederland.

table:columns.name: geom
table:columns.description: Province geometry, multipolygon, in the Dutch national grid EPSG:28992 in meters.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct(xmin double, ymin double, xmax double, ymax double)
table:columns.description: Per-feature bounding box struct in RD New meters, the GeoParquet covering.

data.title: Netherlands Provinces (GeoParquet)
data.description: The 12 province polygons with their names and codes, in the Dutch national grid (EPSG:28992).

source.title: PDOK Bestuurlijke Gebieden 2026 (GeoPackage)
source.description: The PDOK GeoPackage of 2026 administrative boundaries, with the provinciegebied layer that the provinces come from.

visual.title: Netherlands Provinces (PMTiles)
visual.description: Vector tiles of the province polygons for web maps, in one layer named netherlands-provinces.

style-provinces.title: Provinces by name
style-provinces.description: Twelve provinces, one palette colour each.

style-labeled.title: Provinces with names
style-labeled.description: The province colouring with a naam label on each.

style-randstad.title: The Randstad and the rest
style-randstad.description: Noord-Holland, Zuid-Holland, and Utrecht, the provinces of the Randstad conurbation, highlighted orange against the rest in muted green.

style-boundaries.title: Boundary lines only
style-boundaries.description: Province borders as bare lines with no fill, for use over other layers.

thumbnail.description: A PNG map of the province polygons over a light basemap.

metadata.title: ISO 19115 metadata record, BRK Bestuurlijke Gebieden (Nationaal Georegister)
metadata.description: The ISO 19115 metadata record of the BRK Bestuurlijke Gebieden data from the Nationaal Georegister, as XML.
